title: Circle from Three Points
summary: Circumcircle of three points: centre, radius, then D, E, F. 131 bytes.

body.text: Enter (x1,y1), (x2,y2), (x3,y3). Pauses: h, k, r, then D, E, F for x² + y² + Dx + Ey + F = 0. Uses Pol so the first radius pause is r on the display; skip it if you only need the equation coefficients from the later pauses.

body.label: Memory / run mode
body.text: 131 bytes of the shared 680-byte pool. Create the slot in COMP; d/c fractions recommended. Type ? → : ◢ Goto Lbl If Then from SHIFT 3 (P-CMD).

body.caption: Points (2,0), (0,1), (0,4) lie on x² + y² − 4x − 5y + 4 = 0. Centre (2, 5/2), radius 5/2.

body.text: Question: Use this program to solve the case: Points (2, 0), (0, 1), (0, 4).
Question: Use this program to solve the case: Right triangle (0, 0), (6, 0), (0, 8).
Given: Hypotenuse from (6, 0) to (0, 8); centre is the midpoint (3, 4), radius 5.

items: If Math ERROR, swap so two points do not share a y-value as the first pair — enter (0, 8) first: 0 【EXE】 8 【EXE】 0 【EXE】 0 【EXE】 6 【EXE】 0 【EXE】

body.text: Question: Use this program to solve the case: Collinear points.

items: Math ERROR — the three points are collinear

body.label: Pitfalls
body.text: If two points share the same y, the first slope is undefined. Put a point with a different y in the first pair. After the run, RCL A and RCL B are the centre.
